label: Keep File
description: Make a file this run stored outlive the run. Run files are swept when the run ends and unreadable by other runs. `scope: run` (default) only extends THIS run's file, still unreadable elsewhere; `scope: project` copies it into project storage and emits the NEW reference every later run can read (how an upload in one request is served by the next). For a file not yet in storage (a URL), use FetchToStorage.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: Stored run file, of any kind (`File`). Kept in place with `run`; copied (original untouched) with `project`.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Keep as
inputs.description: `run`: survive the end-of-run sweep for `ttlDays`, readable only by this run. `project`: copy into project scope, readable by every later run.

inputs.name: ttlDays
inputs.label: Keep for (days, 0 = forever)
inputs.description: Lifetime since last access (any read, download or link resets it); 0 never expires. Empty: 30 days for a run file, no expiry for a project copy.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: `run`: the same reference, now kept. `project`: the NEW project copy (same name, type, size); later runs read this one. The same kind that came in: a Video stays a Video.
